# ADR 0001: Kernel handoff format and ABI

Status: **accepted** · Milestone: one

## Context

The loader and kernel are compiled separately and must agree on a
register-level handoff contract. The milestone must be provable from the
host using the observed-vs-inferred evidence rule.

## Decisions

### D1. No ExitBootServices in milestone one

The kernel keeps running with the full UEFI Boot Services environment.
Consequences for the hardware contract: the kernel may not touch MMU,
interrupts, timers, or any device directly until a later milestone records
an ExitBootServices design in the contract. Kernel handoff uses Boot
Services memory ownership.

### D2. Handoff ABI (AAPCS64, register arguments on entry)

| register | value |
|----------|-------|
| x0 | kernel image base address |
| x1 | kernel image size in bytes |
| x2 | pointer to the EFI System Table |

## Evidence

The kernel wrote RC.TXT and returned 0. **Observed.** The serial console
behavior is **inferred** — Apple's firmware does not route ConOut there.
Root cause of the scrambled marker file is not yet determined.
